title: What the Price Carries at the Snowsports School, and What the Extras Cost
content:
Some Snowsports School products carry the lift ticket, the rental kit and the supervised lunch in the price; others are sold bare, and the collective publishes an add-on price for each of those three where it is not carried. A helmet and video analysis are carried or not carried, and no add-on price is published for either.

## Inclusions and add-on prices, product by product

| Product | Lift ticket | Lift ticket add-on (USD) | Rental | Rental add-on (USD) | Lunch | Lunch add-on (USD) | Helmet | Video analysis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | not carried | 149.00 | not carried | 59.00 | not carried | 28.00 | not carried | not carried |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | carried | 0.00 | carried | 0.00 | carried | 0.00 | carried | not carried |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | carried | 0.00 | carried | 0.00 | carried | 0.00 | carried | not carried |
| Six-Week Development Programme | not carried | 119.00 | not carried | 49.00 | not carried | 22.00 | carried | carried |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | not carried | 149.00 | not carried | 59.00 | not carried | 28.00 | not carried | not carried |
| Private Instruction Full Day | carried | 0.00 | not carried | 79.00 | not carried | 32.00 | carried | carried |
| Elite Performance Camp | carried | 0.00 | not carried | 89.00 | carried | 0.00 | carried | carried |

The lift ticket add-on price is the price in USD of adding a lift ticket for the session day where it is not carried; the rental add-on price is the price of adding equipment rental for the session day where rental is not carried; the lunch add-on price is the price of adding a supervised lunch where lunch is not carried. Where the product carries the item, the schedule shows 0.00 USD against it.

## The same schedule read by item

- The lift ticket is carried by four products: the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson, the Mountain Cubs Group Lesson, the Private Instruction Full Day and the Elite Performance Camp. Where it is not carried it is priced at 149.00 USD on the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session, and at 119.00 USD on the Six-Week Development Programme.
- Rental is carried by the two children's group products only, and elsewhere runs from 49.00 USD on the Six-Week Development Programme to 89.00 USD on the Elite Performance Camp.
- A supervised lunch is carried by the two children's group products and by the Elite Performance Camp; elsewhere it runs from 22.00 USD to 32.00 USD.
- A helmet is issued at no charge with five of the seven products; the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session do not carry one.
- Video analysis of the participant is carried by the Six-Week Development Programme, the Private Instruction Full Day and the Elite Performance Camp.

## Basis questions on the schedule

**What does the collective charge a household whose participant is booked into the Semi-Private Coaching Session and wants rental kit for the day?** The Semi-Private Coaching Session does not carry rental, and its published rental add-on price is 59.00 USD.

**What does the schedule say about rental for a participant booked into the Mountain Cubs Group Lesson?** Rental is carried in the price of that product, and its rental add-on price stands at 0.00 USD.
